outcomes: A repository declares in one reviewed file the commands its CI runs, and the guidance the CLI generates names them as the gate
A contributor reads one command line — the blocking commands of that file — and knows it is exactly what gates their merge
nonGoals: Writing, validating, formatting, or explaining the file: an extension serves those commands, such as putnami cloud ci
Granting, resolving, or checking any authorization: channels, environments, visibility levels, and approvals are declared here and resolved by the execution plane
Migrating an earlier putnami.ci.json: versions 1 and 2 are not read, and the three repositories that authored them migrated by hand
Owning the runner's own configuration, whose content stays open and is preserved unread

requirements.text: putnami.ci.json declares the ordered commands the runner executes, each blocking unless failOnError is false, and the flags appended to the invocation; the generated agent guidance derives its gate line from the blocking commands.
